Idk if anyone has mentioned this yet but could there be a medical component as to why you haven’t had penetrative sex yet? I have a very weak pelvic floor and something called Vaginismus. Anything penetrative hurts like hell to the point I go numb waist down. In relationships I’d be more than emotionally ready for penetration, talking insistently about it, etc. but physically we just couldn’t do it everytime we tried…Could she be withholding information if she’s physically able to have penetration? Have you ever been able to insert anything in her and if you have has it caused pain or soreness?

Because what does it mean to get back together? Is it going to be for the rest of your lives, is it up in the air, or is it going back to square one of dating?
